'''''Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders''''' is a [[canon]] [[2026]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries to be written by [[George Mann]] and illustrated by [[Partha Pratim]], [[Vincenzo Riccardi]], [[Jagdish Kumar]], and [[Michael Atiyeh]]. The [[The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 1|first issue]] was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[March 25]], 2026.
